methodology.primary: geometric mean of candidate/oracle total p95 across available browser/scenario cells
methodology.gate: pass requires aggregate and every measured total p95 cell to stay within 5% of the oracle; watch is within 10%
methodology.compilerOverhead: geometric mean of evaluate, immediate-get, and lazy-hash p95 ratios
methodology.ordering: runtime gate, then end-to-end total p95; bundle size is secondary and never affects rank
